fanout.en: Parallel fan-out via the harness Task tool (2 subagent workers, captured live from the opencode session DB)
fanout.zh: 经宿主 Task 工具并行扇出（2 个子代理工作节点，实时捕获自 opencode 会话库）

en: Loaded the deep-research skill and smoke-tested the MCP connection (biomcp_gene_search) before any research.
Fanned out two parallel Task workers (BRCA1 HR mechanisms + BRCA1 PARPi resistance); each appended every citable source to a per-aspect evidence ledger and passed the check --markers completion gate.

Orchestrator merged + NCBI-verified the ledgers (sources.jsonl: 34 records, 33/33 markers resolved), drafted with [@pmid:...] cite-key markers; render numbered all 30 citations and generated the Vancouver References with citation locators (volume/issue/pages) wherever the source provides them; vet-references structural audit PASS; interactive HTML rendered by default.
zh: 加载深度研究技能，并在开题前用 biomcp_gene_search 冒烟测试 MCP 连接。
两个 Task 子代理并行工作（「BRCA1 HR 机制」与「BRCA1 PARPi 耐药」）；各自把可引用来源追加进逐方面证据账本，并通过 check --markers 完成门禁。
编排者合并并 NCBI 核验账本（sources.jsonl：34 条，33/33 个标记全部解析），以 [@pmid:...] 引用键起草；render 统一编号 30 处引用并生成 Vancouver 参考文献（来源提供时含卷/期/页码）；vet-references 结构审计 PASS；默认渲染交互式 HTML。
